title: Exact Modular Obstruction Sieves, Direct F_2[X] Kernel-Orbit Factorizations, and Certified Power-Substitution Towers for Binary Irreducible Trinomials
abstract: Extending the elliptic-curve irreducibility criterion of Fu, Li, and Zuo (arXiv:2611.34282v1) for the binary trinomial family T_k(X) = X^{(4^k+2)/3} + X + 1 over F_2[X] (k >= 1, M_k = 4^k + 3, m_k = (4^k + 2)/3), we establish four constructive algebraic, number-theoretic, and machine-checked results. First, we prove unconditionally in Lean 4.36.0 (20 theorems, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice) the exact arithmetic invariants governing k = 1 versus k >= 2: 3 m_k + 1 = M_k, M_k = 1 mod 6, m_k = 2 mod 4, and for all k >= 2 both M_k = 3 mod 16 (forcing quadratic non-residuacity of 2) and m_k = 6 mod 8, together with the Eisenstein norm identity M_k = (2^k)^2 + 3 and exact collapse lcm(o, 6) = o whenever 6 | o. Second, we prove infinite modular obstruction families 7 | M_{3t+1} (composite for t >= 1), 13 | M_{6t+5} (composite for t >= 0), and 19 | M_{9t+2} (composite for t >= 1), establishing exact rational covering densities of 1/2 on Z/6Z from {7, 13}, 5/9 on Z/18Z from {7, 13, 19, 37}, and 53/90 on Z/90Z from {7, 13, 19, 37, 61}. Third, an AST-audited zero-float bit-packed F_2[X] and deterministic Lucas-certificate verifier issues 16 SHA-256 certificates (C01-C16) and passes 71 adversarial pytest checks: exact direct F_2[X] distinct-degree factorizations match the kernel-orbit partition (T_4 splits as 2+12+72 = 86 for M_4 = 7*37; T_5 splits as 4+26+312 = 342 for M_5 = 13*79), deterministic Lucas primality and primitive-root certificates certify irreducibility of T_k up to degree m_{15} = 357,913,942 (M_{15} = 1,073,741,827), and direct Rabin tests certify single- and two-prime power-substitution towers up to degree 147.
